items.name: Jazeera Orange
items.role: the masthead logo block and the section-eyebrow bar. Identity, never interaction.

items.name: Live Red
items.role: breaking bands, LIVE badges, timeline dots, live labels. The color of "happening now" and nothing else.

items.name: Gold
items.role: the network's rule and control-border gilding.

items.name: Amber
items.role: active nav links on network pages.

items.name: Select Gold
items.role: the network's heavy 3px control border on filters.

items.name: Paper
items.role: the news canvas, the nav, the footer.

items.name: Soft
items.role: the newsletter card fill and the faintest divider tone.

items.name: Night Canvas
items.role: the network pages' dark ground for portrait cards.

items.name: Royal Indigo
items.role: the network hero panel behind page titles.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: and Silver (#bebebe): rule tones — list dividers, card edges, and the live-timeline rail.

items.name: Slate
items.role: secondary text, eyebrow labels, the oversized Most Popular numerals, input borders, and the monochrome logo rendering.

items.name: Mist
items.role: light text on the network's dark surfaces.

items.name: Graphite
items.role: network body text and rules on light bands.
